title: Deployment
intro: Finish the API's image definition and the runbook, run the selfcheck, then run the drill and write down what broke.
objectives: Complete api/Dockerfile: WORKDIR, COPY and an exec-form ENTRYPOINT
Write the runbook: health check, rollback, incident
Run the drill and record the setting that broke the deployment

criteria.title: Config completeness
criteria.description: api/Dockerfile carries every instruction the image needs, and no TODO is left.

criteria.title: Isolated selfcheck
criteria.description: The launcher api/Dockerfile declares runs the selfcheck in the sandbox. It does not build an image.

criteria.title: Runbook quality
criteria.description: Health check, rollback and the incident, written for someone who was not there.

drill.description: deploy/shelf.json sets the port to 0, so the service would listen where nobody routes and the selfcheck refuses the configuration.

rules.label: api/Dockerfile sets a WORKDIR
rules.failDetail: Set the directory the instructions below run in, e.g. WORKDIR /app.

rules.label: api/Dockerfile copies the application
rules.failDetail: The image needs api/ and deploy/: add the COPY instructions.

rules.label: api/Dockerfile starts the API in exec form
rules.failDetail: Start the API in exec form, as a JSON array naming python3 and api/main.py.

rules.label: No TODO left in api/Dockerfile
rules.failDetail: Replace every TODO(learner) with a real instruction.

rules.label: The runbook says how to check health
rules.failDetail: Under Health check, write the command an operator runs and the output that proves the service is alive.

rules.label: The runbook says how to roll back
rules.failDetail: Under Rollback, give the command that brings back the previous known-good image.

rules.label: The runbook records the drill's root cause
rules.failDetail: Under Incident, name the setting that broke the deployment and what you changed.

rules.label: No TODO left in the runbook
rules.failDetail: Replace every TODO(learner) with real content.

assistant.systemPrompt: You are the LearnSDLC mentor for the DEPLOYMENT phase of Shelf, a teacher's own application: a Python Flask API that keeps books in memory and a TypeScript React page that lists them. The learner completes api/Dockerfile and RUNBOOK.md and runs the drill. The selfcheck runs the launcher api/Dockerfile declares in an isolated runner; it does not build an image or start a container. Explain concepts and ask guiding questions; never write the learner's answer for them. Keep replies under 120 words and end with one question.

hints: In what order do WORKDIR, COPY and ENTRYPOINT have to appear, and why?
What does exec form hand to the program that shell form would not?
What one command proves the service is alive, and what output says so?
What would an operator type to get yesterday's image back?
The selfcheck refused the configuration: which line of its output names the setting?
What would you write so the next person finds the cause in a minute?

progressive: Start with api/Dockerfile: the three TODOs, in order.
Then the runbook: health check, rollback, incident.
Run the selfcheck, run the drill, and write the incident up naming the setting that was wrong.
